summary.en: Micron's surprise earnings surge reignited the AI trade, with Nasdaq futures jumping ~2% ahead of today's PCE inflation data. Oil markets ignored IRGC threats as WTI tested pre-conflict levels near $78/Bbl while gold fell below $4K amid disinflationary signals.
summary.zh: 美光（MU）意外强劲的财报引发 AI 板块反弹，纳指期货上涨约 2%，今日 PCE 通胀数据公布前市场情绪回暖。油价无视 IRGC 威胁而维持在战前水平附近$78/Bbl，黄金在去通胀信号下跌破$4K。

title.en: Micron (MU) earnings surge +16% after-hours sparks tech rally ahead of PCE data
title.zh: 美光盘后暴涨+16%，点燃科技股反弹，市场关注今晚 PCE 通胀数据

impact.en: Strong Q3 revenue guidance ($50B vs $43.6B expected) and quadrupled margins validate AI memory demand, lifting broad semiconductor/AI ecosystem including Qualcomm (+13%), Sandisk, Western Digital.
impact.zh: 强劲第三季度营收指引（$50B 对预期$43.6B）和四倍毛利率验证AI存储需求，带动半导体/ broader AI生态包括高通(+13%)、闪迪等

macroRisk.en: No - earnings-driven rally, not macro-inflationary pressure. Oil disinflation from Hormuz reopening supports inflation pivot thesis.
macroRisk.zh: 无-业绩驱动的反弹，非宏观通胀压力。霍尔木兹海峡重开带动油价去通胀，支持美联储转鸽论点

title.en: Qualcomm lifts non-handset revenue forecast to $40B, reinforcing AI chip supercycle
title.zh: 高通上调非手机营收目标至$40B，强化AI芯片超级周期逻辑

impact.en: Non-cellular businesses (IoT/automotive/server) surging on generative AI adoption, extending rally to semiconductor ETFs and design houses.
impact.zh: 非手机业务（物联网/汽车/服务器）因生成式AI采用率上升而激增，推动半导体ETF和设计公司

macroRisk.en: No - sector-specific earnings catalyst; macro risk remains PCE data tonight.
macroRisk.zh: 无-板块特定业绩催化；主要宏观风险为今晚PCE数据

title.en: Oil markets ignore IRGC threats as WTI tests $69/Bbl despite Strait of Hormuz tensions
title.zh: 油价无视IRGC威胁，WTI战前测试$69/桶尽管霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势

impact.en: US-Iran peace progress + oil supply reopening disinflationary for inflation data. If WTI < $75/Bbl sustained, supports Fed pivot and rate cuts.
impact.zh: 美伊和平进展+供应重开对通胀数据形成去通胀。若WTI稳定<$75/桶，将支持美联储转鸽和降息

macroRisk.en: Yes - disinflationary oil supports pivot thesis, reduces inflation pressure on PCE readout.
macroRisk.zh: 是-油价去通胀支持转鸽论点，降低PCE读数上的通胀压力

title.en: Gold falls below $4K/oz as USD strengthens and oil prices decline amid risk-on sentiment
title.zh: 黄金跌破$40/盎司因美元走强和油价下跌，风险偏好情绪升温

impact.en: Risk-on flows hit safe havens. Gold/Oil inverse relationship confirmed as inflation expectations ease via oil disinflation.
impact.zh: 风险流入避险资产。黄金与石油的负相关关系得到证实，因油价去通胀降低了通胀预期

macroRisk.en: Yes - declining gold + oil signals easing inflation/strength in USD, could impact PCE perception.
macroRisk.zh: 是-黄金与油价下跌表明通胀缓和/美元走强，可能影响PCE解读

title.en: US May Core PCE expected to print hotter (3.4% core vs 3.3%) - key inflation gauge tonight at GMT 12:30
title.zh: 5月核心PCE预期更热（核心3.4%对前值3.3%）-今晚GMT 12:30关键通胀指标

impact.en: Fed's preferred inflation gauge could reinforce hawkish pivot if hotter than expected, affecting bond yields and stock valuations.
impact.zh: 美联储偏好的通胀指标若超预期可能强化强硬转鸽，影响美债收益率和股票估值

macroRisk.en: Critical - Core PCE directly impacts Fed pivot thesis. Hotter print → higher yields, lower growth stocks.
macroRisk.zh: 关键-核心PCE直接影响转鸽论点。热读数→收益率上升，成长股承压

title.en: Australian jobs beat (40.3K vs 30.3K) but part-time mix raises hawkish RBA inflation debate
title.zh: 澳洲就业数据超预期（40,300对30,300），但兼职比例引发RBA通胀鹰派辩论

impact.en: Sticky core CPI at 3.6% YY keeps RBA rate hike possibility alive; AUD mixed sentiment impacts EM and global rates.
impact.zh: 核心CPI粘性在3.6%年率，RBA加息可能性仍存；澳元分化情绪影响新兴市场和全球利率

macroRisk.en: Moderate - Australian inflation data influences global commodity prices and risk sentiment.
macroRisk.zh: 中等-澳洲通胀数据影响全球大宗商品和风险情绪

title.en: Venezuela 7.5 magnitude earthquake kills up to 100K, US aid pledged but oil impact minimal
title.zh: 委内瑞拉7.5级地震死亡人数或达10万，美国提供援助但油价影响微乎其微

impact.en: Catastrophic event impacts Venezuela economy; minor supply disruption vs Middle East tensions.
impact.zh: 灾难性事件冲击委内瑞拉经济；供应中断相对中东紧张局势为轻微

macroRisk.en: Low - regional crisis; oil supply impact negligible vs Hormuz geopolitical risk premium.
macroRisk.zh: 低-区域危机；油价供应影响相对霍尔木兹地缘政治风险溢价可忽略

ai.en: AI rally reignited by Micron's earnings validation of memory demand. NVIDIA (NVDA), AMD, Super Micro all benefit from accelerated Capex cycles in data centers and edge AI.
ai.zh: 美光业绩验证存储需求点燃AI板块。NVIDIA、AMD和华为等受益于数据中心和边缘AI的资本开支加速周期

semiconductor.en: Broad semiconductor rally: Qualcomm (+13%), Sandisk, Western Digital, Marvell on AI chip supercycle. Semiconductor equipment (AMAT, LRCX) and materials also lifted.
semiconductor.zh: 全面半导体反弹：高通(+13%)、闪迪、西部数据等在AI芯片超级周期中受益。半导体设备和材料也受到提振

bigTech.en: Big tech holding steady. NVDA/AMD rally on AI memory demand narrative; MSFT, GOOGL following cloud/AI infrastructure spend. Sectors mixed if PCE data disappoints.
bigTech.zh: 大科技维持稳定。NVDA和AMD受益于AI存储需求叙事；MSFT、GOOG跟随云/AI基础设施支出。若PCE数据令人失望，板块分化

energy.en: Oil (WTI $69) testing pre-conflict levels as US-Iran peace progress + Strait of Hormuz reopening creates disinflationary backdrop. XLE under pressure vs USO bullish on supply fears.
energy.zh: 油价(WTI$69)测试战前水平，因美伊和平进展+霍尔木兹重开形成去通胀背景。XLE承压而USO对供应担忧看涨

ev.en: EV sector (RIVN, LCID, NIO) lags on broader auto sentiment and macro uncertainty. Battery supply chain benefits from AI data center electrification but consumer demand weak.
ev.zh: 电动车板块(RIVN、LCID、NIO)在总体汽车情绪和宏观不确定下落后。电池供应链受益于AI数据中心电气化但消费疲软

market.en: Risk-on sentiment with Nasdaq futures +2%, S&P +0.6% on Micron catalyst. Breadth expanding into semiconductor/AI ecosystem, but PCE data remains key uncertainty.
market.zh: 风险偏好情绪，纳指期货+2%，标普+0.6%因美光催化。广度扩展到半导体和AI生态，但PCE数据仍为关键不确定性

preciousMetals.en: Gold fell below $4K/oz as USD strengthens and oil disinflationary signals ease inflation fears. Silver hit lows near$56/Oz on risk-on flows hitting safe havens.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金跌破$40/盎司因美元走强和油价去通胀信号减轻通胀担忧。白银受风险偏好流入避险资产触及低点约$56

oil.en: WTI testing $69/Bbl vs Brent at $78.36 below 200-day SMA. US-Iran peace progress reduces geopolitical risk premium despite IRGC threats. Venezuela earthquake impact negligible.
oil.zh: WTI测试$69/桶对布伦特在$78.36低于200日移动平均。美伊和平进展减少地缘政治风险溢价尽管IRGC威胁。委内瑞拉地震影响可忽略

futures.en: Nasdaq +1.8%, S&P +0.6%, Dow +0.2% on Micron/Qualcomm earnings catalysts.
futures.zh: 纳指+1.8%，标普+0.6%，道指+0.2%在美光和高通业绩催化下

treasury10Y.en: ~3.95-4.0%, easing on oil disinflation and dovish ECB signals ahead of PCE.
treasury10Y.zh: ~3.95%-4.0%，因油价去通胀和对PCE之前鸽派ECB信号而回落

dxy.en: 107-108 range on risk-on flows and oil disinflation easing inflation fears.
dxy.zh: 107-108范围因风险偏好和油价去通胀减轻通胀担忧

oil.en: WTI $69.5/Bbl, Brent $78.36 testing support levels pre-conflict Iran tensions.
oil.zh: WTI$69.5/桶，布伦特$78.36测试战前伊朗紧张局势支撑水平

keyRisk.en: US May Core PCE inflation data at 12:30 PM GMT (today). Hotter than expected → higher yields, lower growth stocks; cooler supports rate cut pivot.
keyRisk.zh: 美国5月核心PCE通胀数据于今日GMT下午12点公布。超预期热→收益率更高，成长股更低；较弱支持降息转鸽

note.en: Mixed sentiment: AI rally driven by earnings (bullish) but macro uncertainty from PCE data tonight keeps risk-off potential. Oil disinflation supports pivot, but if Core PCE ≥ 3.5% core YoY, yields could spike and tech underperforms.
note.zh: 混合情绪：AI板块由业绩驱动（看涨），但今晚PCE数据的宏观不确定性保留风险规避潜力。油价去通胀支持转鸽，但若核心PCE≥3.5%，收益率可能飙升而科技股表现疲软
